# Array Dipoles: a Matlab script for simulating the magnetic field generated by an array of permanent magnets 

The script allows to compute the magnetic flux density generated by an array of permanent magnets of parallelepipedic shape. This tool is particularly conceived for simulating array of permenent magnets for generating the static magnetic field (B0) of very-low-field magnetic resonance scanner, using the quasi-Halbach configuration.<br>
The script is developed in Matlab 2022a environment.<br>
The executable, running under Windows 11 or Windows Server 2019/2022,  requires the Matlab runtime R2022a (9.12).<br>

## Operation

The script is run under prompt command.<br>

Once the script is run, it will produce as output the magnetic field values in a list of geometrical point (usually identifying the DSV of the scanner) and the parameter of magnetic field homogeneity in the considered volume.<br>

Two main types of simulations are possible:
- deterministic simulations, where the input data are assumed to be known and results are consequently computed.
- stochastic simulations, using Monte Carlo method, where a set of input parameters are assumed to be known in terms of statistical distribution. The output quantities are also obtained in terms of statistical distribution with expected value and standard deviation.<br>


## Usage

Before running the script, the input data should be properly prepared following the instruction described in the Documetation.md file.<br>


## Example

Two example are made available in the examples folder of the repository, one for the deterministic and one for the stochastic simulation.<br>
